description: Send a free-estimate request to Kay1 Electric on the customer's behalf. Kay1 receives it by email and calls the customer back during office hours (7:00 AM - 9:30 PM daily, Pacific Time); if an email is given, the customer also gets a confirmation email. Only call this after showing the customer the details and getting their explicit OK to send them and be contacted. Do not invent details. Not for emergencies: for sparking, burning smells or no power, tell the customer to call (778) 900-1004 now (911 for fire or danger to life).

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant or app sending this request, e.g. "ChatGPT" or "Claude".

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the customer reviewed these details, asked you to send them to Kay1 Electric, and agreed to be contacted by phone or email.

details.description: Short description of the job: property type (house, condo, business), current panel size if known, what needs doing or what is wrong. No links.

email.description: Customer email (optional). If given, a confirmation email is sent to it.

phone.description: Customer phone number with area code (North American), e.g. "604-555-0123".

preferred_language.description: Language the customer prefers for the call back.

urgency.description: How soon the work is needed.

name: request_quote
title: Request a free estimate
